SBI SCO Wealth & Other Post Online Form 2026 – Full Details

State Bank of India (SBI) has released the notification for the post of Wealth & Other Posts. This recruitment has been issued for 207 posts. Online applying process for SBI SCO Wealth & Other Post Recruitment 2026 has started from 04 September 2026 & the candidates can apply till 25 September 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for SBI SCO Wealth & Other Post Recruitment 2026 which has given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 04 September 2026
  • Last Date : 25 September 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 25 September 2026
  • Exam Date : Notify Soon
  • Admit Card : Before Exam
  • Result : Will Be Updated Here Soon

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 750/-
  • SC, ST, PH : 0/-

How to Apply Online

  1. Click on the direct Apply Online link in the Important Links section below.
  2. Complete new registration with your Name, Email, and Mobile Number.
  3. Fill the application form with personal, educational, and address details.
  4. Upload scanned photograph, signature, and required certificates.
  5. Pay the applicable examination fee online and download the submission receipt.
